name: Pitten Chao
source:
Pitten Chao is an experienced and talented knight from the Parancho Kingdom, a small self-sufficient kingdom that resides in the Free Cities Alliance, where he had the title of Major General. 

He wears a majestic golden armor and is respected and known for being the strongest in Parancho, being nicknamed "The Flawless Golden Knight". In battle, he's noted for having a very high magical resistance and great taunting skills.

[Edited from [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Pitten_Chao]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
